parts:
Dear all,

I would like to draw your attention to these excellent Stats intro workshops run by Mike Meredith and his colleagues in the SE Asia region. Perhaps start negotiating with your PhD advisor that you need to travel there...

Best regards  ----- Marc
From: Mike [work...@bcss.org.my]
Sent: 03 July 2019 13:59
Subject: Stats Boot Camps and other training opportunities

Greetings everyone,

The "Boot Camp" at University of Mandalay (2-14 July) has just started with all places taken. The August "Boot Camp" in Thailand (19-30 Aug) is now fully booked and the waiting list is closed too.
 
We will run a "Boot Camp" as a pre-meeting event in Sri Lanka, 29 Aug - 9 Sept, before the ATBC-Asia Pacific Chapter meeting. Details of the main meeting are here, and we are #7 on the workshops page here. To register for the workshop, you first need to register for the meeting. Register by 7 July to get early-bird rates.

Please pass on this information and the link to bcss.org.my to your friends and colleagues who would be interested and we hope to see you at one of our workshops soon.

Regards,  Mike

PS: If you don't want to receive these emails in future, just hit "Reply" and let me know.
-- 
Mike Meredith
BCSS Vice-Chair and Workshop Coordinator
Pls use work...@bcss.org.my for workshop-related stuff
